source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2. Properties
source.quote: As of June 30, 2025, our principal offices consist of approximately 146,000 and 147,000 square feet of leased office facilities in Sydney, Australia and the San Francisco Bay Area, California, United States, respectively.

notes: Only long-lived assets are disclosed by country (U.S., Australia, India, all other); unit is thousands of U.S. dollars. The 10-K gives 13,813 full-time employees with no breakdown, and lists the countries with employees (Australia, Canada, France, Germany, India, Japan, the Netherlands, New Zealand, the Philippines, Poland, Singapore, South Korea, Turkey, the U.S. and the U.K.) without counts. The FY25 Sustainability Report was checked: it has office electricity by country but no headcount by country. Revenue by geography is in the records and not repeated.
